kind: CHORA experiment/dev registry — the HAND's side of the board
law: This file is intent. docs/kanban.md and docs/kanban.json are RENDERED from it by bin/kanban.py and must never be hand-edited.
A row may claim any lane it likes; the board prints the derived lane and marks the row red when they disagree (CLAIM DRIFT). Claiming ahead of the bytes is cheap to do and impossible to sustain.

Every anchor is re-checked on each run: pre-registration commits for ancestry in their own bench, artifacts for the four-way check (pinned ∧ on-disk ∧ sha256==pin ∧ tracked), letters for bench-commit ∧ mirror ∧ index, and provenance repo@sha for resolvability IN THIS CLONE.
Never delete a row. Retire it: keep its last true claim and write what happened into `notes`. Negative results are first-class (law 4).

rows.title: H6c — the same dial read from two ends: does the evidence path, shown only the INIT geometry, walk where gradient descent later lived?
